name: TECHNAX
recent: Techna-X 近期推进两项资产出售：以 RM45 million 出售 HK Aerospace Beidou 50% 股权，并以 RM7 million 出售 Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) 45% 股权。公司同时出现多名董事变动，包括 Tunku Kamariah 在获委任后数日即辞任。此外，Bursa Malaysia 因未披露 RM45 million 香港资产出售而公开谴责公司。
notable: 拟以 RM45 million 现金出售 HK Aerospace Beidou New Energy Technology 50% 股权给 Tess Global Sdn Bhd。
拟以 RM7 million 出售 Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) 45% 股权给 ZhengHe International Trade Import & Export (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.。
Bursa Malaysia 公开谴责 Techna-X Berhad。
risks: Bursa Malaysia 就未披露的 RM45 million 香港资产出售公开谴责公司。
Tunku Kamariah 在获委任为董事后数日即辞任，同期出现多项董事变动。
HK Aerospace Beidou 股权出售的长期截止日已延长至 2027 年 4 月 18 日，交易尚未完成。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM3.798 million，环比增长 1.8%，但同比下跌 76.0%；净利为 RM0.708 million，净利率 18.6%，高于上一季度的 1.3%。

recent_en: Techna-X is progressing two asset disposals: the sale of a 50% stake in HK Aerospace Beidou for RM45 million and a 45% equity interest in Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) for RM7 million. The company also saw several boardroom changes, including Tunku Kamariah resigning days after her appointment. In addition, Bursa Malaysia publicly reprimanded the company over an undisclosed RM45 million Hong Kong asset sale.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of a 50% stake in HK Aerospace Beidou New Energy Technology to Tess Global Sdn Bhd for RM45 million cash.
Proposed disposal of a 45% equity interest in Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) to ZhengHe International Trade Import & Export (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. for RM7 million.
Bursa Malaysia publicly reprimanded Techna-X Berhad.
risks_en: Bursa Malaysia publicly reprimanded the company over an undisclosed RM45 million Hong Kong asset sale.
Tunku Kamariah resigned days after her board appointment, alongside several other boardroom changes.
The long stop date for the HK Aerospace Beidou disposal has been extended to 18 April 2027, and the transaction is not yet completed.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3.798 million, up 1.8% QoQ but down 76.0% YoY; net income was RM0.708 million with an 18.6% net margin, up from 1.3% in the previous quarter.
